Hundreds detained as protesters demand Gyanesh Kumar resign over SIR

Police detained more than 150 protesters near the Election Commission office in New Delhi on Saturday, officials said, as a march against the Special Intensive Revision of voter rolls was stopped at barricades.

The protesters demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Organisers claimed 5,000 people took part; police put the number at 1,200.
